scope: Actual production full Bern map-only offscreen renderer; no Client, HWND, Level actors, sky, local map lights, UI, sound or physics. Saved camera viewpoints at cue times, dt=0; not animated full-game cutscene replay.
sourceMeasurement: Offscreen throughput: 8 warmup frames, GPU event drain, CPU wall time over 16 normal render preparations and submissions, final GPU event completion. No Present/vsync. Last measured frame includes draw recording; detailed source traversal, query readback, image and JSON writing are outside timing. N=16 is a short sample subject to OS/GPU clock variation; not Client FPS.
interpretation: Baselines are explicit: each camera and mip uses both LOD/HLOD OFF and both ON; toggles hold the other switch fixed.
delta=candidate-baseline, reduction=baseline-candidate, ratio=candidate/baseline; positive reductionPercent means less geometry.
Mip-only comparisons hold camera and both geometry switches fixed and compare mip 1/2/3 against mip 0.
VS invocations are hardware shader invocations, not unique vertices or allocated vertex-buffer size.
Indices and draw counts describe the final measured frame, not the sum of all 16 timed frames.
Invalid query, unknown indirect, dropped rows, or changed non-axis settings suppress affected numeric comparisons.
This is a 16-frame offscreen map-only throughput sample with no Present, actors, sky, local map lights, sound or physics; it is not Client FPS or proof of a meaningful speedup.
The end/start duplicate checks one camera at mip0 with both geometry switches ON only. Exact geometry equality is reported without an invented tolerance; timing drift is observational.
MOC/HiZ wall-time budgets and GPU/OS clock variation can affect repeatability; geometry drift is flagged, not assigned an unsupported cause.
